name: nats-admin
description: Operate NATS from VS Code: auto-discovered contexts, production-safe connections, fleet/server/stream/cluster dashboards, health checks, topology graph, Key-Value data-structure browser, message browser, live tail, consumer lab and JetStream config as code.

viewsWelcome.contents:
A NATS server is listening on localhost:4222.
[$(plug) Connect to localhost](command:nats.connectLocal)

No NATS connections yet.
NATS CLI contexts (~/.config/nats/context), NATS_URL and workspace connections (setting nats.connections) appear here automatically.
[Add Connection](command:nats.addConnection)
[Show Hidden Connections](command:nats.showHiddenConnections)
Secrets are kept in your OS keychain via VS Code SecretStorage.

Health checks analyse streams, consumers, buckets, the JetStream account and the server against NATS best practices.
[$(pulse) Run Health Check](command:nats.runHealthCheck)

commands.title: Copy NATS CLI Contexts into VS Code…
Select Target Connection for Config Folder

nats.explorer.showInternalStreams.description: Show the streams backing KV buckets (KV_*) and Object Stores (OBJ_*) in the Streams folder.

nats.kv.keySeparator.description: Character used to group KV keys into folders in the explorer tree (NATS subjects use '.'). Set to an empty string for a flat list.

nats.kv.maxKeys.description: Maximum number of keys loaded per bucket in the explorer tree and KV Browser. Only keys and metadata are loaded up front; values are fetched on demand.

nats.kv.prettyPrintJson.description: Pretty-print compact JSON values when opening a KV key. On save, values that were compact are stored compact again.

nats.messageBrowser.pageSize.description: Number of messages per page in the Message Browser.

nats.liveTail.maxMessages.description: Maximum number of messages kept in a Live Tail panel (older messages are dropped).

nats.dashboard.refreshInterval.description: Server, stream and cluster dashboard polling interval in milliseconds.

nats.confirmDestructiveActions.description: Ask for confirmation before deleting or purging streams, consumers, buckets, keys and objects.

nats.objectStore.maxPreviewBytes.description: Objects larger than this many bytes are not opened in an editor (download them instead).

nats.contexts.autoDiscover.description: Show NATS CLI contexts (nats context ls) in the explorer automatically and keep them in sync with the context files.

nats.contexts.directory.description: NATS CLI context directory. Empty = $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nats/context or ~/.config/nats/context.

nats.connections.markdownDescription: Connections shared with your team through workspace settings (no secrets — passwords, tokens and seeds are prompted once and stored in the OS keychain). Each entry: `name`, `servers`, optional `auth` (`kind`: none | userpass | token | creds | nkey, `username`, `credsFile`, `nkeyFile`), `tls`, `monitorUrl`, `environment` (dev | test | staging | prod), `readOnly`.

nats.connections.fromEnvironment.description: Offer a connection built from NATS_URL / NATS_USER / NATS_PASSWORD / NATS_CREDS / NATS_NKEY when NATS_URL is set.

nats.connections.restoreOnStartup.description: Reconnect the connections that were open when VS Code was closed.

nats.explorer.autoRefresh.description: Refresh the explorer when JetStream advisories report created, updated or deleted streams and consumers.

nats.explorer.statsRefreshInterval.description: Refresh stream and consumer statistics in the explorer every N seconds (0 = off).

nats.explorer.maxSubjects.description: Maximum number of subjects listed under a stream's Subjects node and in the stream dashboard.

nats.health.autoRun.description: Run a health check automatically after connecting.

nats.health.intervalMinutes.description: Re-run health checks every N minutes for live connections (0 = off).

nats.health.pendingWarning.description: Warn when a consumer has more unprocessed (pending) messages than this.

nats.health.ackPendingRatio.description: Warn when a consumer's ack pending count reaches this fraction of max_ack_pending.

nats.health.storageWarningRatio.description: Warn when a stream or account uses this fraction of its storage / message limits.

nats.health.storageErrorRatio.description: Report an error at this fraction of a storage / message limit.

nats.health.rttWarningMs.description: Warn when the client ↔ server round-trip time exceeds this many milliseconds.

nats.overview.refreshInterval.description: Refresh interval (ms) of the Overview sidebar and Home dashboard.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with NATS Admin

[Open Topology](command:nats.openTopology)

steps.title: Run a health check
steps.description:
Find misconfigurations and lagging consumers before they page you.
